data.content_ref: inline:Compatibility: SRC_002's defeater pre-pass is compatible with SRC_012's committed-root checkpoint because the checkpoint runs post-fixpoint on surviving edges only, so it layers onto the defeater-filtered graph without altering the monotone fixpoint or adding edges. Refuted if a defeater warrant removes the sole defending edge of a committed root, leaving the checkpoint unable to distinguish a root defended by UNDECIDED from one defended by a removed edge.
